A few days ago I asked what you would like to change, so I figured I'd ask what you like about the game as well :D For me, I love the feeling you get when both your team and the enemy team are trying their hardest and the match is a constant back and forth. Even if we end up losing, I feel satisfied at the end knowing that we did everything we could.
What is your favourite part of League of Legends?

My favorite part is when a team I'm playing on suddenly just clicks on teamwork or communication. Engages are in sync as if we are on Teamspeak or some other voice chat, and we are all working on the same page for objectives, ganks, picks, etc. For me, the cohesiveness of a team resulting in a win makes me want to re-queue up right away.

All the sudden a team fight starts, 3 ults are perfectly landed one after another to destroy the enemy team, then you think... huh, I should have guessed that combo off the champion select screen. B, rinse and repeat.

I'm not sure. I somehow open the client every time I boot my pc though. Something is pulling me towards the game again and again.

There are three scenarios that give me a good feeling though.
First is the one OP describes. Close games, back and forth, keeping the enemy of our Nexus turrets and then push for the win. When it's close like that, it doesn't matter if you win or lose. It has been a good game.

The second scenario is when you have a rough start, but somehow you manage to hold on, get back, get ahead and absolutely destroy the enemy. Bonus points for you yourself being the one leading and carrying your team out of the hole.

Third is one vs one an enemy who is ahead and killing him. When I sometimes make a difficult play and come out winning, I feel my legs tingling. I probably get so tensed, that I flex my leg muscles or something. When that happens and I 1v1'ed an enemy, I know that it was a good play (well, for me at least).

I remember hearing something on the radio the other day. For evaluating something, your brain thinks of the emotional high point, (good or bad), and how you feel at the end of it. So that have something to say with it.
